Round 1: SECURITY PASS at 7380b7ced3bcfc40bc58411581e0bef8c843750b.

Reviewed the original b65235f2056ff44000ad19034fd8c261aa92168c diff against main 85c38c1c, then checked the replacement delta within the same round. The replacement is one direct-child commit changing only docs/difficulties.md (+1/-1, unchanged permissions). Both Rust test blobs remain identical. D-F228-1 at line 190 is unchanged; D-F229-1 at line 191 replaces the prohibited machine-local diagnostic-report locator with a path-free description. C21 is resolved.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 1 | ⚪ LOW | docs/difficulties.md | 191 | C21 machine-local path exposure in the original head; resolved in this head | 10/10 |

No unresolved security findings. The original scope is three files: crates/tmux/tests/adapter.rs (+88/-47), crates/daemon/src/compaction_wake_tests.rs (+58/-22), and the ledger (+2/-0). compaction_wake.rs:373-375 loads the latter module under cfg(test); no production behavior or security guard changes.

The added teardown probe invokes tmux directly with argument arrays and the fixture's isolated -L server namespace (adapter.rs:2225-2227,2275-2286), not shell evaluation or a fleet-wide kill. The fake-tmux mutation wrapper is not committed. The added ledger text contains no secrets, usernames, private repository identities, or remaining prohibited home paths; the crash summary uses aggregate counts and stack symbols, not raw crash-report metadata. No dependency, lockfile, production loop, poll, hook or daemon launch site changed; steady-state production cost and per-seat scaling are unchanged.

Validation: just pr-freeze 278 --worktree passed on the replacement full head, confirming gh/ls-remote agreement, main base, CLEAN, non-draft, unchanged migration numbering, and all five latest checks passing. The new detached tree is clean. The separately published reviewer verdict at this same head records 20/20 real-tmux CAS runs, 20/20 cancellation runs, macOS clippy, and a teardown-survivor mutation; these are the reviewer's receipts, not security's own reruns.

Local validation limit: harness boot reported advisory NOT-READY because the dependency-free read-only review tree lacks vitest. Security's full harness checks attempt at the superseded head was stopped when the PM requested a hold; no local full-gate pass is claimed. No dependencies were installed or symlinked. Security proof is the scoped diff and ledger-delta assessment plus frozen exact-head CI; correctness reruns remain owned by reviewer/278.

Known limit: the separately tracked F229 tmux crash is not fixed by this test-only PR.

Harness feedback / magicWand: the C21 finding required a manual changed-ledger check. Recommend a diff-scoped public-ledger privacy sensor covering both absolute and home-relative paths, rather than widening operational portability checks indiscriminately. This is an encoding suggestion, not a merge blocker or an additional review round.
